_HOW_TO: This file is a COPY-PASTE DEMO. Your live file is my_links.json — same shape.
v2.5: my_links.json is HOT-RELOADED — edit it and the NEXT search already uses it. No restart.
v2.5: you can skip files entirely — set the MYLINKS env var on the scraper OR on the bot:
Your links are tried FIRST and their results LEAD the list (the bot downloads images[0]).
The three URL forms that work:
-> page fetched as-is AND the domain is boosted via Bing 'your-query site:pngtree.com'
-> fetched AS-IS (the path already says what to grab — do not append ?s= yourself)
-> {query} is replaced by the search word. Works with any site that has a URL search.
'type': 'image' for picture sites, 'gif' for GIF sites. 'enabled': false switches a slot off without deleting it.
HOW TO CHECK YOUR SLOTS ARE ALIVE (v2.5 diagnostics):
-> every slot shows lastResult: { count, error, ts }
count > 0 = working; count 0 with 'JS-walled' note = the site needs JavaScript
(the Bing site: boost still finds its images — that is automatic).
A dead slot NEVER breaks a search — it is skipped and logged.
